requiredFindings.title: An omitted capability echo faults; it cannot negotiate the token off
requiredFindings.detail: The FA-2 controls require a case with the census token offered without its HelloAck echo and label that outcome negotiated off. NE section 9.1 requires exact token-array equality in both protocols, and FA-2 retains that handshake. A Hello containing symbol-census-v1 followed by a HelloAck omitting it must fault before any OpenUniverse/source disclosure. Accepting the exchange and switching to historical payloads would silently weaken the signed selection and contradict the unchanged exact-echo rule.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Replace the negotiated-off outcome with PROVIDER.PROTOCOL_VIOLATION before disclosure, for TS2 and Rust3. Keep the lawful token-absent historical branch only when both exact arrays omit the token. Make explicit that all optional tokens retain exact echo, including the Rust reference-scope token; test both omission and unoffered addition without continuing the session.

requiredFindings.title: Give each new control the refusal point assigned by the plan
requiredFindings.detail: Section 4 says every RF-2 control passes the closed schema and refuses at contextual admission. That cannot hold for all the listed controls. Every TS2/Rust3 FactBatch carrier, historical and V3, declares 1..4096 facts/candidates: zero or 4097 entries fails the closed payload schema at LD-D2B-12 step 8, before admission step 9. In addition, planStage byte equality and request stageOrdinal construction are assigned to the host builder by section 3, rather than to received-worker-frame admission. The blanket expected phase conflicts with the revised check order and the otherwise sound ownership table.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Partition these controls by owner and refusal point: shape/count-bound violations at schema admission, host request projection/Plan-stage mismatches in the builder or sender before writing, and well-shaped worker stage/Analyze/batch/candidate correlation and T020 mismatches at contextual admission. Keep the before-publication guarantee. Do not bypass earlier schema checks or move host checks into worker admission merely to satisfy the current test wording.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Attribute the inline Analyze frame-size gap to schedule sizing
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The statement that refusing more than 256 inline subjects closes RUST3-LIM F-1 is imprecise. F-1 is an oversized inline Analyze even at or below the subject cap, due to repeated rows, stages and path lengths. LD-D2B-9 already supplies the correct full-envelope sizing and pre-spawn schedule refusal. Cite that mechanism here and include an at-or-below-256 oversized-inline control, distinct from the 257-subject cap case.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Name the occupancy and transitive schema consumers in the pattern allocation
nonBlockingObservations.detail: OWNER-PATTERN-EVALUATION explicitly scopes the occupancy-companion schema in the wire consumer as well as evidence/startup and the H relation-payload consumer. The table currently names D2b startup checks, H relation payloads and the Plan evidence schema. State that D2b applies the selected pattern semantics to its occupancy companion and transitive external wire schemas too; listing the carrier admission ID once should not be mistaken for covering only the startup root.
